_meta.rule: Only facts stated on those pages appear here. Anything GMRC does not state is recorded as null with a `_missing` note rather than filled in from elsewhere.
_meta.notInApp: Service timings are published by GMRC only as timetable images (effective 18/05/2026) and could not be read as text, so they are NOT recorded here.

discounts.quote: Passengers using CSC for travelling will be given 10% discount on completion of journey. / All the passengers travelling using NCMC are offered 10% discount on completion of journey.
discounts.note: Display only. These are never applied to a computed fare - fares shown in the app are token fares.

childrenFree.quote: Two Children only under 3-feet height are allowed to travel free if accompanied by one adult.

ticketValidity.quote: Paper QR valid within 30 minutes of issuance; mobile QR within 180 minutes.

luggage.quote: Weight 25 Kg and Dimension of 80 cm x 50 cm x 30 cm

penalties.reason: Taking a token out of the system

penalties.note: maximum fare from the last four transactions

refunds.quote: Only unused QR-Paper Ticket/Token (not used for the entry) can be refunded within 30 minutes from time of issue.
refunds.smartCard: Stored value is not refundable in cash. Security deposit is refunded less a Rs.20 admin charge and any negative balance.
refunds.ncmc: Refunds and disputes are handled by the issuing bank, not GMRC.

phaseRestriction.quote: Travel using tokens/CSC is permitted only within Phase 1 stations, not between Phase 1 and Phase 2.
phaseRestriction.note: Confirmed on GMRC fare-rules. This is what the cross-phase warning in journeyEngine reports.

smartCard._missing: GMRC's smart-cards page does not state card price, deposit, or stored value. The '₹100 = ₹50 deposit + ₹50 value' figure circulating on third-party sites is NOT confirmed by GMRC and is deliberately not recorded here.

ncmc._missing: GMRC does not state a price; NCMC is issued by banks.
ncmc.purchase: Through card-issuing banks. NCMC issued from any bank is accepted on the GMRC network.

unverified.touristDayPassRs100: Seen on third-party sources only. Not found on any GMRC page checked. Do not display.
unverified.serviceTimings: Third-party sources claim 06:20-22:05. GMRC publishes timings only as images; not confirmed. Do not display.
